app_full_name: Kitaab Bank – Smart School Book Exchange
search_placeholder: Search books by title, author, subject, or code...
hero_title: Share Knowledge, Pass On Your Books
hero_title_line1: Don't Let Old Books Sit on Shelves.
hero_subtitle: Kitaab Bank connects school students to donate completed textbooks and request the books they need for the new academic session. Supervised by school teachers.
featured_books_sub: Verified textbooks ready for collection at the school desk.
how_it_works_sub: A simple, four-step process to give educational books a second life in our school.
step_1_desc: Enter details of an unused textbook you no longer need and submit it for teacher review.
step_2_desc: School teachers check the condition and syllabus relevance before publishing to the catalogue.
step_3_desc: Browse available books for Class 6, 7, or 8 and request what you need without complex registration.
step_4_desc: Collect your verified book directly from the school teacher's desk and start learning.
catalogue_sub: Browse, search and filter verified curriculum books available for peer exchange across Classes 6, 7 & 8.
no_books_found: No textbooks matching your filters were found.
author: Author
subject: Subject
book_reserved_notice: This book is currently reserved by another student.
book_unavailable_notice: This book is currently not available for requests.
related_books_sub: More books available for this grade and curriculum.
scan_qr_desc: Scan this QR code to quickly look up this book in the school system.
donate_sub: Hand over your past year's textbook to a junior student in need. Every verified book empowers another learner.
donate_consent: I confirm that this book is complete and in usable condition for school study.
donation_submitted_desc: Please bring the physical book to the school teacher desk with this reference code.
request_sub: Request an available book for your studies. Your request will be reviewed by teachers at the school desk.
request_submitted_desc: Save your tracking code to monitor status and collect your book at the school desk.
track_sub: Enter your unique tracking code (e.g. KB-REQ-XXXX) to check the status of your book request.
scan_sub: Look up textbook details instantly using your device camera or manual code entry.
scan_camera_desc: Point your camera at a textbook QR code sticker.
login_sub: Authorized access for school teachers and administrators.
teacher_dashboard_sub: School textbook circulation, inventory management, student requests and handover desk.
modal_confirm_text: Are you sure you want to proceed with this action?
demo_banner_desc: Operating with sample curriculum textbooks. Real school database is preserved in automated backups.
footer_text: Kitaab Bank – Offline-first school textbook circulation system.
footer_tagline: Empowering every student with accessible learning materials.
all_rights_reserved: All rights reserved. Designed for offline school deployment.
atomic_reservation_desc: After submitting, you will receive an unpredictable Tracking Code. Once approved by a teacher, the book is locked and reserved exclusively for you. Your phone number and roll number remain strictly confidential.
author_placeholder: e.g. Sindh Textbook Board, Prof. Memon
book_info_desc: Provide the details of the school book you wish to donate.
book_title_help: Official book title as printed on the front cover.
book_title_placeholder: e.g. Mathematics for Class 7, General Science
browse_other_copies: You can browse the school catalogue for other available copies.
camera_insecure_desc: Mobile web browsers restrict direct camera access to Secure Contexts (https:// or localhost). On plain local Wi-Fi, camera hardware is protected by browser policy.
camera_insecure_title: Mobile Camera Requires HTTPS or ngrok Tunnel
camera_tunnel_hint: Exhibition mode: Run run_tunnel.py to activate camera scanning on phones
cancel_reservation_heading: State Reason for Releasing Reservation Back to Catalogue
default_cover_notice: Default curriculum cover will be used
desc_placeholder: Mention syllabus edition year, included chapters, or any notes that help teachers and fellow students...
donate_guarantee_text: Every submitted textbook is verified by school teachers. If approved, the book is cataloged with an official reference code. Your phone and roll numbers are never published.
donor_info_desc: Your name is recorded for school acknowledgement and teacher supervision. Contact details remain strictly private and will never appear in the public catalogue.
handover_success_desc: This educational textbook has been officially handed over to you for your academic studies.
login_hint: Default School Staff Account: teacher / Teacher@123
pending_explanation: Your request is currently awaiting teacher verification. School teachers review requests daily to ensure fair allocation. Once approved, the book will be reserved for you.
photo_upload_help: Supported formats: JPG, PNG, WEBP (Max 3 MB). Helps teachers verify condition faster.
photo_upload_prompt: Click to attach a clear picture of the book cover
privacy_notice_redacted: Student phone numbers and school roll numbers are confidential and strictly redacted from public tracking lookups.
rejection_placeholder: Explain why this book cannot be accepted into the catalogue...
request_next_steps_desc: A school teacher will review your request. Once approved, this book will be reserved exclusively for you. Bring your school Roll Number to the school library/teacher desk to collect the book.
request_reason_placeholder: e.g. Need this book for daily classwork and exam preparation...
requester_info_desc: Enter your correct school identifiers. Teachers will verify this information during physical handover.
reserved_good_news: Good News! Your Book is Reserved!
reserved_explanation: The book has been locked and reserved exclusively for you. Please visit the school library or teacher desk with your Roll Number to collect your textbook.
roll_no_help: Used by the teacher to verify your identity when you collect the book.
sample_codes_title: QUICK SAMPLE BOOK CODES (Click to Test):
scan_manual_desc: Every cataloged textbook has an official 6-digit identifier (e.g. KB-BK-000001). Type the code or just the number below:
settings_sub: Configure school profile, rotate administrative credentials, generate hot database backups, or seed exhibition mode.
track_how_it_works_desc: When you submit a book request, a private 16-character code is generated. Enter it above to see whether your book has been approved and reserved for collection.
track_step_1_desc: Input your code from the request confirmation.
track_step_2_desc: See live status (Pending, Reserved, Handed Over).
track_step_3_desc: Collect your reserved book from the teacher desk.
verification_action_desc: Confirm the book condition matches the school syllabus. Approving will generate a unique book code and immediately publish the listing in the public catalogue.
what_next_desc: A school teacher will review this book. Once the condition and curriculum relevance are verified, the book will automatically receive an official code and appear in the public catalogue for fellow students to request.
teacher_supervision_desc: Every submitted textbook is verified by school teachers. If approved, the book is cataloged with an official reference code. Your phone and roll numbers are never published.
